label: qa06-confirm-pending
method: Temporary ACCESS EXCLUSIVE authorization-read lock in a rolled-back transaction; no field or product mutation. Nominal 20-second automatic hold; measured setup/release duration is retained separately. Server statement and idle-in-transaction timeouts are 25 seconds.
timingQualification: Measured duration includes setup/release overhead and can exceed the nominal hold. Artificial delay is excluded from performance samples.
